name: Ben Duoc Temple
nameVi: Đền Tưởng niệm Liệt sĩ Bến Dược
kicker: Memorial temple on the Bến Dược ground
summary: Memorial temple at Bến Dược: walk the hall and the nine-floor tower on the tunnel day, for the names inside. The hall sits on the ticketed Bến Dược ground, after the forest path from the tunnels. Stage 1 opened on 19 December 1995. Book Bến Dược if the hall is part of the day.
heroCaption: The memorial hall, dragons along the roof, courtyard in front

notice.title: The hall is on the Bến Dược ground
notice.body: You reach the memorial after the forest path on the Bến Dược visit. The other gate is Bến Đình, on Provincial Road 15.

body: You reach the memorial after the forest path on the Bến Dược ground. The hall has a dragon roof over a wide courtyard. Work started on 19 May 1993, and stage 1 opened on 19 December 1995. The walls carry 45,666 names. Nine display sections use the title Sài Gòn – Chợ Lớn – Gia Định kiên cường, bất khuất.

A tower of nine floors stands 39 meters beside the hall. From the top you can see part of the Tam giác sắt, the wartime ground around Bến Dược. The same yard holds a three-gate entrance, a stele house, and a garden. The temple covers 40,299.3 m².

Give the hall the same day as the tunnels at Bến Dược. The gate is 7:00–17:00, including Saturday, Sunday, and Tết. From 1 February 2026 a foreign visitor pays 35,000 đồng for the historical site and 100,000 đồng for the guide. The two lines stay separate. The ticket at the Bến Dược gate is the one that brings you to the hall.

figures.caption: The three-gate entrance on the way into the memorial
figures.alt: The three-gate entrance of Ben Duoc Temple, with the name on the beam and the path through to the hall

gettingThere: The memorial is on the Bến Dược ground at ấp Phú Hiệp, xã An Nhơn Tây. From the city centre the road takes about one hour. The tunnels are also placed at about 70 km northwest, with Provincial Road 15 and Phú Hiệp in the same line.

legs.heading: From the city centre
legs.body: By road, about one hour to Bến Dược. A taxi is quoted at 600,000–700,000 đồng a trip, with no gate on the quote. Self-drive follows Trường Chinh, ngã tư An Sương, Hóc Môn, then Provincial Road 15.

legs.heading: By bus to Bến Dược
legs.body: Bus 13 from Bến Thành, or 94 from Chợ Lớn, to the Củ Chi bus station, then 79 to Bến Dược. Route 79 is also called Củ Chi – Dầu Tiếng.

closed: No weekly closing day. The relic gate includes Saturday, Sunday, and Tết. The memorial uses that gate. After 17:00 the grounds are quiet except on a Trăng chiến khu night.
admissionNote: The memorial is inside the ticketed Bến Dược visit. Foreign visitors, from 1 Feb 2026: historical-site admission 35,000 đồng a person a visit, and a service-and-guide ticket 100,000 đồng a person a visit. The two lines stay separate. Incense: Check on arrival. A Vietnamese adult price and child bands: Check on arrival.
